notes.title: Project Pulsation: vote on Greenlight
notes.content:
Hi all,

Cubic Bundle is proud to present a new indie game by Vitaly Gintsar - Project Pulsation

Project Pulsation is a sci-fi horror FPS with stealth elements.


VOTE for Project Pulsation on Greenlight and we will make sure to include the game in our bundle!

notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
We heard you like options, so we put some options in your options, so you can choose options while you play.

Another small pretty update for those you who:
- Hated 'КИСЛОРОД' screen
- Hated scanlines
- Likes to see how many times Yury died

Enjoy the rage quits.

notes.title: Yury - update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thank you for your feedbacks on the game.
We have just released a new update 1.0.2 for you with following features:

Resolution change
Windowed/full screen mode option
Controls re-mapping
Joystick support


http://i.gyazo.com/900e9335c45eeb9e90fe2c1ac74a238a.png

We hope this will make game experience more enjoyable!
